---
title: "Trust in the Defence Forces"
description: "How far people in Ireland trust the armed forces, compared with other countries."
---

In 2025, 69% of people in Ireland said they trust the armed forces, a little above the average of 66% across the countries in the OECD Trust Survey. Trust in the Defence Forces was about the same as trust in the Gardaí, at 69%, and well above trust in the government or the Oireachtas.

{{< chart defence-trust-armed-forces >}}

Trust in other public institutions, including the electoral system, is covered on the [Trust in institutions](../elections/trust.qmd) page.
